title: Smoke Detector Fire Kaise Sense Karta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Smoke detector dhuan nahi, kuch aur dekhta hai! Jaaniye ki alarm andar se kaise kaam karta hai.
🔬 Ionization chamber ke andar kya hota hai
⚡ Smoke aane par current kaise girta hai
💡 Photoelectric alarm light ko kaise pakadta hai
🛏️ Bedroom ke liye kaunsa alarm better hai
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
